review_findings: The successor owns only composition and generated configuration; it delegates every live decision to existing authorities.
A closed project-relative declaration removes handwritten factories without making untrusted Host input executable.
Local-only assembly is a valid strict subset and does not silently substitute for a configured missing integration.
The built-in factory has no WriteAuthorityGuard and therefore preserves fail-closed mutating behavior.
Product source and standalone dependencies remain outside the approved paths.

skill_rule_mappings.assessment: all Hosts use skillctl host plus the same built-in concrete factory
composition constructs existing owners and adds no duplicate state writer
initializer cannot configure or grant write authority
all generated Harness files live under .harness and do not become application dependencies
